items.title: Why Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Stock Is Trading Up Today
items.summary: Shares of enterprise technology company Hewlett Packard Enterprise (NYSE:HPE) jumped 3.9% in the morning session after Morgan Stanley upgraded the stock to Overweight from Equal Weight and set a $69 price target. The firm said it had been “on the wrong side” of the enterprise hardware trade and now sees a stronger setup for HPE’s server business. Morgan Stanley’s shift rests on pricing and order strength. items.title: Wall Street Analysts See a 25.36% Upside in Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE): Can the Stock Really Move This High?
items.summary: The mean of analysts' price targets for Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) points to a 25.4% upside in the stock. While this highly sought-after metric has not proven reasonably effective, strong agreement among analysts in raising earnings estimates does indicate an upside in the stock.

items.title: Dell, HPE gain pre-market as SMCI posts blowout revenue guidance
items.summary: Dell Technologies (NYSE: DELL) and Hewlett Packard Enterprise (NYSE: HPE) are rising in sympathy ahead of the open, as investors treat SMCI’s results as a live demand barometer for the entire AI server hardware sector. When SMCI previously reported disappointing results, Dell shares fell in tandem — and the reverse dynamic is now playing out. DELL is up 2.6%, while HPE is up 2.2%.
